newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian real drops 0.07 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian real drops 0.07 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.07 percent to close at 1.0642 per dollar in calm trading on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The real's fall was due partly to expectations of a decline in the real-dollar mini-band in coming days, they added.
The current mini-band was set by the Central Bank on Wednesday at between 1.0635 and 1.0685 reais per dollar.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0688 per greenback, down 0.02 percent.
In the parallel market, the real rose 0.18 percent to end at 1.135 per dollar, traders said.
